facts.label: Youngest age for a national ID card
facts.where: Opening paragraphs
facts.note: The Election Commission extended NID services from age 18 to citizens aged 16 and 17. A newly registered student may not yet hold the smart card with a chip that IELTS requires. The notification was issued on 22 February under Article 5 of the National Identity Registration (Amendment) Act 2010; the page does not show the year. No official copy could be found online, so Pathway uses this reported value.

facts.label: IELTS in Bangladesh: accepted ID (British Council)

value.text: A valid passport or a smart national ID card with a chip, used for booking and brought as the original on test day. Students under 18 also need a parent consent form. IELTS is not recommended under age 16.

facts.where: Section: What you need to register for IELTS with the British Council, item 1
facts.note: British Council rules. For IELTS for UKVI, only a passport is accepted.

facts.label: IELTS Academic at British Council Bangladesh

value.text: Offered as a computer test at British Council centres.

facts.where: Table under: Choose how to take your IELTS test and book online

facts.label: IELTS Academic fee at British Council Bangladesh
facts.where: Table row: IELTS Academic, in centre (computer)
facts.note: Older figures on other websites are out of date.

facts.label: IELTS Academic at IDP Bangladesh

value.text: Offered on computer at IDP centres in Dhaka for BDT 31,100, with results in 1 to 5 days and One Skill Retake available.

facts.where: Test session list for Dhaka, sessions on 5 October 2026
facts.note: Same fee and result time as the British Council. One Skill Retake lets a student retake a single section instead of the whole test.

facts.label: IELTS on computer: time until your official result
facts.where: Section: When will I get my IELTS results?
facts.note: The result can be seen online 24 to 48 hours after the test. The official report, which universities need, can be downloaded 1 to 5 days after the test. The plan counts the official report and shows up to 5 days.

facts.label: How long universities accept an IELTS result
facts.where: Section: How long are my IELTS results valid for?
facts.note: Organisations usually refuse results more than two years old.

facts.label: Retaking IELTS

value.text: There is no limit on retakes. A test can be booked again as soon as you are ready.

facts.where: Section: Can I re-take my IELTS test to improve my IELTS results?

facts.label: Asking for an IELTS re-mark (British Council)

value.text: Apply no later than six weeks after the test. The fee is BDT 12,500, refunded if any section's score goes up. The new result can take up to 21 days.

facts.where: Section: How can I get my IELTS test re-marked?

facts.label: IELTS bands and the CEFR (IELTS)

value.text: C2 is bands 8.5 and 9; C1 is 7, 7.5 and 8; B2 is 5.5, 6 and 6.5; B1 is 4, 4.5 and 5. Bands 5, 6.5 and 8 sit on the border between two levels.

facts.where: Chart of IELTS bands against CEFR levels
facts.note: Read from the chart on the page in a browser. IELTS stresses that its bands and the CEFR levels cannot be matched one to one.

facts.label: How IELTS works out the overall band

value.text: The overall band is the average of the four section bands, rounded to the nearest half band. An average ending in .25 rounds up to the next half band, and one ending in .75 rounds up to the next whole band. Bands of 6.5, 6.5, 5.0 and 7.0 average 6.25, so the overall band is 6.5.

facts.where: Paragraphs on how the overall band score is calculated, with worked examples

facts.label: TOEFL iBT: time until your official score report
facts.where: First paragraphs
facts.note: Scores reach your ETS account 3 days after the test, and the PDF score report is ready 1 day after that. The plan shows up to 4 days.

facts.label: TOEFL iBT: time until universities receive your score
facts.where: Section: Sending your scores
facts.note: Counted from when scores are released, 3 days after the test. ETS Data Manager takes 4 to 8 business days and server feeds 8 to 10. The plan uses up to 10 business days.

facts.label: TOEFL iBT: free score reports

value.text: The test fee includes up to four free score reports. Their recipients must be chosen by 10 p.m. on test day.

facts.where: Sections: Sending your scores and Additional score reports
facts.note: So the plan asks the student to choose four universities before test day. Each extra report has its own fee (see the next fact).

facts.label: TOEFL iBT: each extra score report
facts.where: Other fees: additional score reports (per institution or agency)
facts.note: Prices exclude VAT or other taxes. Older pages give USD 25.

facts.label: TOEFL iBT test fee in Bangladesh
facts.where: Registration fee table, Bangladesh
facts.note: Excluding VAT or other taxes. Registering within 7 days of the test costs USD 49 more, and rescheduling costs USD 69. Checked in a browser, because the country table loads by script.

facts.label: TOEFL iBT score scale

value.text: Since 21 January 2026, scores are on a 1 to 6 scale in half points, for each section and overall. During a two-year transition, reports also show a comparable overall score on the old 0 to 120 scale.

facts.where: Section on the new score scale

facts.label: How long a TOEFL score is valid
facts.where: First paragraphs

facts.label: TOEFL iBT in Bangladesh: accepted ID

value.text: A valid passport with your name, photograph and signature. There are no exceptions.

facts.where: Country list: Bangladesh, Bangladesh acceptable primary ID documents
facts.note: Shown only after choosing Bangladesh in the page's country list. A national ID card is not accepted.

facts.label: IELTS scores on the TOEFL iBT 1 to 6 scale (ETS)

value.text: ETS's estimates: IELTS 9, 8.5 and 8 are about TOEFL 6; 7.5 is about 5.5; 7 about 5; 6.5 about 4.5; 6 about 4; 5.5 about 3.5; 5 about 2.5; 4.5 about 2; 4 about 1.5.

facts.where: Table comparing IELTS and the new TOEFL iBT scale
facts.note: ETS says it cannot predict an exact score on another test.

facts.label: The TOEFL iBT 1 to 6 scale and the old 0 to 120 scale (ETS)

value.text: 6 matches 114 or more on the old scale; 5.5 matches 107 or more; 5, 95 or more; 4.5, 86 or more; 4, 72 or more; 3.5, 58 or more; 3, 44 or more; 2.5, 34 or more; 2, 24 or more; 1.5, 12 or more; 1, 0 or more.

facts.where: Table of comparable total scores
facts.note: Until January 2028, score reports also show the comparable score on the old scale.

facts.label: The TOEFL iBT 1 to 6 scale and the CEFR (ETS)

value.text: 6 is C2; 5.5 and 5 are C1; 4.5 and 4 are B2; 3.5 and 3 are B1; 2.5 and 2 are A2; 1.5 and 1 are A1.

facts.where: Scale alignment with the CEFR

facts.label: How ETS works out the TOEFL iBT overall score

value.text: On the 1 to 6 scale, the overall score is the average of the four section scores, rounded to the nearest half band: an average of 5.125 gives 5, and 5.25 gives 5.5. On the old 0 to 120 scale, the overall score is the sum of the four section scores.

facts.where: Paragraphs on how the overall score is calculated

facts.label: The comparable 0 to 120 score on a new TOEFL iBT report

value.text: During the transition, a report on the 1 to 6 scale also shows a comparable total on the 0 to 120 scale: the midpoint of the range the overall score matches. A 4.5 comes with a 90.

facts.where: Paragraph on the comparable total score, and the answer on what a 4.5 comes with
facts.note: ETS lists no single number for each band. Where a range's midpoint falls between two whole numbers, Pathway shows both.

facts.label: Duolingo English Test: time until your result
facts.where: Help: faster results
facts.note: Standard results take two days. Paid faster results take 12 hours, are not refundable and do not guarantee a certified result.

facts.label: Duolingo English Test in Bangladesh: accepted ID

value.text: A passport or a driving licence. A national ID card is not accepted for Bangladesh. Photocopies, handwritten IDs and pictures of an ID on a phone are refused, and the name entered must match the ID exactly.

facts.where: Help: accepted identification and the ID table, row Bangladesh
facts.note: A student without a driving licence needs a passport for this test.

facts.label: Duolingo English Test score scale

value.text: Scores run from 10 to 160 in steps of 5.

facts.where: Section 2.1, Overall Score
facts.note: Every score is a multiple of 5, so the plan's score question moves in steps of 5.

facts.label: How long a Duolingo English Test result is valid
facts.where: Answer to the question in the title
facts.note: After two years the result cannot be shared, and universities can no longer view its certificate.

facts.label: Duolingo English Test price
facts.where: Choose test quantity, after signing in
facts.note: USD 59 each when two are bought together, shown down from USD 140. The same price in every country before tax. Checked in a browser after signing in.

facts.label: Duolingo English Test scores, the CEFR, IELTS and TOEFL (Duolingo)
facts.where: Score comparison table
facts.note: TOEFL here is the old 0 to 120 scale. Duolingo says the new TOEFL scale does not change the meaning of its scores, and points to ETS for the new scale.

facts.label: How Duolingo works out the overall score

value.text: The overall score is an average of the four subscores, Listening, Speaking, Reading and Writing, rounded up to the nearest 5.

facts.where: Section 2.1, Overall score, and section 2.2, Subscores
facts.note: Duolingo's blog says the average is rounded to the nearest 5. Pathway's check holds either way.

facts.label: Indian visa for Bangladeshi citizens

value.text: India resumed regular tourist visas for Bangladeshi citizens on 28 June 2026, after a suspension of nearly two years. There is no e-visa for Bangladeshi passport holders, so every application goes through an IVAC centre.

facts.where: Opening paragraphs
facts.note: Needed for countries whose permit appointments are in India, such as Finland. IVAC centres have closed suddenly before, for example in Chattogram in December 2025.

facts.label: Indian visa processing time
facts.where: Section: The visa situation
facts.note: Longer just after the June 2026 reopening because of demand. The plan adds two weeks of spare time around this step.

facts.label: Bangladesh police clearance certificate: how to apply

value.text: Apply online at pcc.police.gov.bd with a Bangladeshi mobile number and a valid passport. The police station of the permanent address handles it. The government fee is BDT 500.

facts.where: Requirements list
facts.note: Needed for some visas, such as New Zealand's. A passport comes first.

facts.label: Police clearance certificate processing time
facts.where: Opening section
facts.note: Officially 7 to 15 working days; realistically 4 to 6 weeks, longer outside Dhaka. The plan uses up to 6 weeks (30 working days).

facts.label: Bangladesh Mathematical Olympiad team for the IMO

value.text: For the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad, students first took an online selection round, then regional maths festivals in 15 cities, a national festival in Dhaka and a national camp. The Bangladesh Mathematical Olympiad Committee chose the six-member team from the camp and selection tests. The team ran from class 10 to class 12.

facts.where: Team announcement for the 66th IMO, 22 June 2025

facts.label: Bangladesh Physics Olympiad

value.text: Run by the Bangladesh Physics Olympiad Committee. In 2025 about 10,000 students entered the regional round and about 1,400 reached the national round, and five students were chosen to represent Bangladesh at the International Physics Olympiad.

facts.where: Report on the 2025 national round, 5 March 2025

facts.label: Bangladesh Chemistry Olympiad

value.text: Run by the University of Dhaka's Department of Chemistry with the Bangladesh Chemical Society. The 2026 preliminary round was held in 15 regions, with the final round at the Department of Chemistry, and its winners could take part in the International Chemistry Olympiad.

facts.where: Event notice for the 2026 olympiad

facts.label: Bangladesh Biology Olympiad

value.text: Organised by the Bangladesh Biology Olympiad Committee. In 2026 students came through 10 regional biology festivals to a national round of written and multiple-choice tests on the International Biology Olympiad syllabus, and 20 went on to a camp to prepare the team for the International Biology Olympiad.

facts.where: Report on the 2026 national round, 9 May 2026

facts.label: Bangladesh Olympiad in Informatics

value.text: A national programming olympiad for pre-university students, run by the Bangladesh Informatics Olympiad Committee and modelled on the International Olympiad in Informatics.

facts.where: Report on the 2024 olympiad, held on 26 and 27 April 2024

facts.label: Bangladesh at the International Olympiad in Informatics

value.text: Bangladesh has taken part in the International Olympiad in Informatics since 2004, and won its first gold medal there in 2024.

facts.where: Report of 6 September 2024

facts.label: Bangladesh Olympiad on Astronomy and Astrophysics

value.text: Run by CASSA, the astronomy centre of Independent University, Bangladesh. Students pass regional rounds in Junior, Senior and Open categories, and the national round chooses the team for the International Olympiad on Astronomy and Astrophysics.

facts.where: Notice of the 2026 national round, 18 April 2026

facts.label: International Junior Science Olympiad team from Bangladesh

value.text: Bangladesh's team for the International Junior Science Olympiad is chosen jointly by the Bangladesh Science Popularization Association and the Bangladesh Freedom Foundation. The 2025 team of six included students from class 8 to class 10, and all six won bronze medals.

facts.where: Report of 6 December 2025

facts.label: Bangladesh AI Olympiad

value.text: Organised by the Bangladesh Open Source Network. Students go through regional and national rounds and a national selection camp, which chose four students for the 2026 International Olympiad in Artificial Intelligence. They won three bronze medals.

facts.where: Report on the 2026 International AI Olympiad

facts.label: Bangladesh Economics Olympiad

value.text: Run by the Bangladesh Economics Olympiad Foundation. For 2025, five students were chosen from nearly a thousand to represent Bangladesh at the International Economics Olympiad, a competition in economics and finance for high school students.

facts.where: Report of 16 July 2025

facts.label: NASA Space Apps Challenge in Bangladesh

value.text: Run in Bangladesh by BASIS. In 2024 teams took part in a 36-hour hackathon in nine cities, and the projects of the 27 winning teams went on to NASA's global judging.

facts.where: Report of 6 October 2024

facts.label: Paying study fees abroad by card

value.text: Since 10 August 2026, banks may issue a debit, prepaid or credit card for paying tuition and other approved education costs to institutions abroad, in the student's name or in the name of the person paying for the studies. These payments are not counted against the travel quota.

facts.where: FE Circular No. 29, paragraphs on eligible payments and card holders
facts.note: The circular does not name application or test fees, so ask your bank about those. The Daily Star reported the same rules on 11 August 2026.

facts.label: Yearly travel quota for an adult

value.text: USD 12,000 for each calendar year.

facts.where: Paragraph on the travel quota
facts.note: Card payments for studies abroad are separate from this quota.

facts.label: Student file for paying study costs abroad (Bank Asia)

value.text: A student file pays tuition, housing, living costs and health insurance abroad under Bangladesh Bank's rules. It needs the offer letter, the I-20 for the USA, the university's cost estimate and refund policy, your certificates, your passport and photos. Bank Asia charges Tk 5,500 the first time and Tk 5,000 to renew after a year.

facts.where: Service description, documents and charges
facts.note: One bank's service, shown as an example. Other banks offer the same file with their own charges.
